intake.mission_link: Develop source-grounded algorithm inspiration for general MARL in which each active agent may select, retain, terminate, and renew a skill on its own state- and event-dependent period instead of sharing one fixed duration. The campaign must address asynchronous primitive/decision/termination/renewal clocks, semi-Markov credit, initiation and termination support, exploration and exploitation, skill reuse and collapse, partner co-adaptation, external membership changes, and survivor-state continuity.
intake.authorized_source_boundary: Validated MyLib Metadata v2 corpus with its registered structured JSON/PDF evidence, plus only sections 1 and 3 of docs/project/ALGORITHM_PRINCIPLES.md.
exclusions: No CURRENT_WORK, formal science/runtime/review state, project code, implementation, workflow state, Git, experiments, scientific compute, web browsing, or External Pro.
No papers/temp, retired catalog.jsonl, legacy Markdown, source outside the authorized MyLib boundary, or automatic formal promotion.

Do not treat a fixed option horizon, asynchronous external agents, ordinary action repetition, communication delay, or variable external team size as direct evidence for learned per-agent skill periods.

Do not expose a favored prior answer to the first innovation roster and do not run a global contest among directions; each direction competes only against its own parent and matched simpler explanations.
intake.completion_meaning: Complete source absorption; preserve the user-provided starting directions plus open source-derived alternatives after the absorption barrier; complete constructive principles analysis for every retained direction and adversarial review for every validation-ready direction; close actionable corrections; and process or explicitly park every material in-boundary opportunity in all six opportunity classes without selecting a global winner.

campaign.prior_advisory_context_policy: Existing local_research starting directions are withheld from Scouts and first-cycle Innovators until SOURCE_ABSORPTION_BRIEF is frozen; afterward they may enter only as named parent directions, not as source evidence or favored answers.

packets.summary: Direct period evidence separates initiation-time repeat choice, target-state stopping and environment-defined asynchronous macro lengths. No assigned source directly learns general multi-agent skill periods.
established_results: UTE chooses duration at initiation and then counts down.
DCSL stops on target-state attainment with a hard cap.
ACAC and VSP expose distinct elapsed-time, event and atomic-step credit units.
failure_boundaries: Direct duration controllers are single-agent or use predefined/environment-defined durations.
Atomic-step proxies can give longer actions more gradient mass.

packets.summary: Skill identity is a code, categorical variable, effect cluster or transferable semantic index; duration is a separate fixed scheduling choice or per-step reselection.
established_results: VO-MASD, HMASD and CD3T use externally selected shared periods.
DT2GS preserves identity semantics under per-step reselection.
failure_boundaries: None defines a learned hazard, completion detector or duration distribution.
Interval reward sums confound identity value with duration unless accounted for.

packets.summary: The sources distinguish irregular primitive-decision, retrospective context, fast/slow learning, logical progress, within-step order, message-age and wait/termination clocks.
established_results: Elapsed time belongs in continuous-time value and gradient targets.
Context length can be controlled independently of primitive actions.
Event progress can define boundaries without being duration.
failure_boundaries: Clock analogies do not establish skill-period control.
The entropy-threshold waiting source contains a formula/prose direction inconsistency.

packets.summary: Hierarchy spans fixed temporal abstraction, asynchronous variable-duration safe skills, same-step coordination, action-space roles, training-distribution generalization and model routing; only HMARL-CBF supplies explicit variable termination.
established_results: HMARL-CBF binds initiation, termination, timeout and safety and reselects asynchronously.
BiKT separates team tactic from individual skill realization.
CEC shows specialization can erase generalization.
failure_boundaries: CBF safety is conditional on initial safety, dynamics premises and QP feasibility.
Role, tactic, instruction and expert labels do not imply slow clocks.

packets.summary: Context identity, relation state, action adapters, partner history, stable prefixes and fast/slow memory persist at different granularities and need distinct renewal rules.
established_results: Multiscale validity tests support change-triggered renewal.
Stable prefixes need an explicit support-mismatch dropout.
Representation and decision mappings can be protected independently.
failure_boundaries: Stale prefixes and over-regularization can inhibit adaptation.

packets.summary: Directed exploration needs useful coverage, novelty or influence; random noise, entropy magnitude, model capacity and policy population size are insufficient.
established_results: Novelty-gated policy diversity excludes distinct-but-sedentary behavior.
Finite-trial mixture entropy encourages complementary coverage.
Exploration modes and signals can interfere and may need adaptive control.
failure_boundaries: Policy populations and training-stage exploration modes are not variable skill periods.
Composition invariance can suppress distinctions needed for coordination or diversity.

packets.summary: Marginal contribution, temporal causal decomposition, directed influence, gradient routing, targeted intervention and factorization expressivity answer different credit questions.
established_results: Semi-Markov transfer requires explicit boundary events, elapsed-time discount, masks and causal windows.
failure_boundaries: Retrospective causal analysis is not automatically a training signal.
Same-step and one-step methods do not establish delayed skill credit.

packets.target_problem: Separate reusable skill identity value from duration, accumulated return, exposure and partner co-adaptation.
packets.mechanism: Duration-blind identity-conditioned actor plus a separate local continuation hazard, crossed period probes, gradient firewalls and exposure-matched semi-Markov credit.
packets.prediction: Identity main effects survive clamped-period and accounting-matched comparisons; otherwise report explicit identity-period coupling.
packets.simple_alternative: Capacity-matched recurrent period-only controller without a discrete identity.

packets.target_problem: Credit initiation-time duration choices under asynchronous execution without atomic-step or partner-event multiplication.
packets.mechanism: Store a duration score at initiation and release exactly one elapsed-time semi-Markov gradient at the initiating agent's own boundary; atomic losses cannot update the duration head.
packets.prediction: Context-correct periods and duration gradients remain invariant to reward-preserving atomic duplication and extra teammate union events.
packets.simple_alternative: Tuned fixed duration with identical asynchronous ledger and exposure accounting.

packets.target_problem: Avoid transient target-hit completion while separating staleness, timeout and safety.
packets.mechanism: After first target entry, require exactly one same-skill confirmation transition; use exclusive cause arbitration and support-conditioned multiscale staleness.
packets.prediction: Two-hit basin confirmation lowers transient completion and renewal churn only where target persistence is the intended semantic.
packets.simple_alternative: One-hit target termination with all other components matched.

packets.target_problem: Identify when independent, synchronous-first-request or softly coordinated termination is warranted.
packets.mechanism: One common local request head is transformed by three matched execution interfaces; the soft mode uses only an aggregate request bit and follow/defer gate.
packets.prediction: Soft following helps only at intermediate coupling and must survive timer, sham-message, communication-cost, exposure and held-out-partner controls.
packets.simple_alternative: State-blind identity-conditioned timers matched on duration, boundary count and co-termination.

packets.target_problem: Declare independent completion without using elapsed duration and without confusing noisy, aliased, partner-induced or unsafe states with success.
packets.mechanism: Cross-gate robust effect-set membership, accepting logical progress, observability/support and safe handoff at distinct evidence events; timeout and interruptions are competing causes.
packets.prediction: Completion decisions are invariant to duplicated no-change frames and improve unseen-path completion only beyond a matched nonlearned conjunction.
packets.simple_alternative: Nonlearned conjunction using identical effect, logic, support and handoff inputs.

packets.target_problem: Preserve reusable recurrent context across appropriate boundaries while resetting stale execution or partner state.
packets.mechanism: An explicit renewal action and cause-by-validity-scale lattice controls survival of fast, slow, identity and keyed partner components; full reset remains fail closed.
packets.prediction: Component interventions reduce post-boundary regret under interleaved timescales only if a matched recurrent hazard cannot learn the same transfer map.
packets.simple_alternative: One undifferentiated recurrent state with the same continue/renew head and whole-state retain/reset gate.

packets.target_problem: Explore periods through useful progress, outcome coverage or identifiable influence rather than duration entropy, noise or capacity.
packets.mechanism: Choose a nominal period by predicted marginal useful boundary-outcome coverage, allow completion/support truncation, and update once from the realized cause-coded boundary.
packets.prediction: Reach useful boundary cells faster without higher duration entropy or longer mean duration, including against held-out partners.
packets.simple_alternative: Least-covered positive-progress boundary-cell period chooser without mixture, influence or partner modeling.

packets.target_problem: Preserve a shared tactic through benign individual completions while reopening it when accumulated incompatibility evidence warrants renewal.
packets.mechanism: A shared tactic lease constrains compatible skill rebinding; cause-coded local boundary tokens update a commonly observed renewal accumulator and tactic changes only at a synchronized rendezvous.
packets.prediction: Reduce unnecessary tactic switches and forced interruptions under legible heterogeneous completion without hiding a centralized information channel.
packets.simple_alternative: Fixed shared tactic horizon with independent within-tactic skill rebinding and no boundary evidence into tactic renewal.

packets.principle_summary: Identity-period factorization is an interventional crossed-design claim. Recurrent age leakage, unsupported cells, partner compensation and identity-period interaction must be measured rather than suppressed.
constructive_refinements: Treat clamped period and realized duration as different variables.
Use a fixed probe horizon shorter than every supported period.
Publish input and gradient-edge contracts and compare a fully matched recurrent period-only controller.

packets.principle_summary: Escrow is correct asynchronous SMDP estimator bookkeeping, not a new reward source. One score per decision removes record multiplication but not short-period decision-frequency, shared-encoder or censoring bias.
constructive_refinements: Use immutable decision IDs and behavior-policy versions.
Firewall every shared parameter path or declare the coupling.
Separate sham ledger events from genuine partner-policy changes and physical-time frame refinement.

packets.principle_summary: BCTT is a two-positive one-step persistence filter, not proof of a dynamical basin. Its value must exceed generic dwell, hysteresis, smoothing and partner compensation while counting latency and overshoot.
constructive_refinements: Preclassify persistent versus first-passage targets.
Use exclusive competing causes and own-boundary credit.
Add unconditional duration-matched dwell and held-out noncompensating partners.

packets.principle_summary: The triad changes reachable joint boundary subsets. The one-bit OR is an information channel whose hazard saturates with group size; direct interface effects must be separated from request-policy co-adaptation.
constructive_refinements: First freeze one common request policy, then permit mode-specific relearning.
Use leave-one-out peer OR and pivotal credit.
Match channel, capacity, timers, exposure and partner conventions.

packets.principle_summary: Effect-logic completion is a structurally gated cause-specific discrete-event survival model. Local identifiability, unique event keys, provenance semantics and competing-risk censoring are central.
constructive_refinements: Separate semantic completion from executable safe handoff.
Let a learned residual reject but never override a failed hard gate.
Compare against the identical deterministic conjunction and firewall age leakage.

packets.principle_summary: MSSR is a Dec-POSMDP belief-state and reset intervention. The applied mask is itself an information channel, and explicit renewal differs from recurrence only through event action, credit and interventionally testable semantics.
constructive_refinements: Freeze a fail-closed cause-by-validity lattice.
Declare block inputs and prohibit an always-surviving scratchpad.
Use single-component retain/reset/swap interventions against a matched recurrent hazard.

packets.principle_summary: UCOPE creates a self-interacting marked renewal process. Useful cause-coded boundary outcomes, not duration labels, define directed finite-trial coverage, and adaptive counts require opportunity/propensity accounting.
constructive_refinements: Begin with the exact positive-progress count baseline.
Merge nominal periods with indistinguishable truncated outcome laws.
Use safe cold-start probes, stable outcome semantics and held-out partner statistics.

packets.principle_summary: Lease-gated tactic rebinding is a hierarchical Dec-POSMDP with common-transcript and commitment requirements. Public tokens are not common knowledge without acknowledged epochs, and strategic token manipulation is possible.
constructive_refinements: Start with fixed tactic semantics and a small deterministic token vocabulary.
Use epoch-numbered acknowledged transcripts, membership handshakes, minimum dwell and hysteresis.
Cross skill substitutions within tactic and compare matched fixed horizons plus a centralized oracle gap.

actionable_corrections: Bypass the learned hazard and force identical probe boundaries in the crossed identity-period estimand.
Firewall recurrent age, duration, capacity and gradient paths and require supported crossed cells.
Use shared label alignment, dummy and shuffled codes, persistent-noise controls and held-out partners.
Make paired behavioral utility, not latent separability, the primary identity test.
packets.smallest_discriminator: Paired 2x2x2 identity by period by training-or-held-out-partner probe with fixed boundaries and a fully matched recurrent dummy-code control.
